name: BlindStick Companion Blind Stick BLE Protocol
notes: Only publish distance_cm when a fresh valid ultrasonic measurement exists; the app clears the displayed measurement when a packet omits it.
Object detections, person counts, and traffic-lamp estimates are computed on the phone from JPEGs returned by the local camera AP, not sent by the ESP32 firmware.
Local hardware warnings must continue if the phone disconnects once assistance is active.
The traffic-lamp estimate is not a pedestrian-signal detector. Never infer permission to cross from a green/red/amber estimate.
The motor output must be driven through a suitable transistor/MOSFET circuit; never drive a motor directly from a GPIO.
HC-SR04 ECHO is commonly 5V and must be level-shifted to the ESP32's 3.3V input limit.
